item.title: GAA on TV: All-Ireland club finals take centre stage
item.description: There will be live television coverage of the All-Ireland club hurling and football finals from Croke Park this weekend.

item.title: "Every county does go through a transitional phase"
item.description: On November 15 of last year, Cork football legend Juliet Murphy found herself at The Bonnington Dublin Hotel for a very special occasion.

item.title: Armagh, Cavan and Fermanagh penalised after McKenna Cup rule breaches
item.description: Armagh, Cavan and Fermanagh have been sanctioned after it emerged that all three teams fielded Sigerson Cup listed players in their midweek outings in the Dr McKenna Cup.

item.title: Galway into Connacht FBD League final after Thompson double helps see off Leitrim
item.description: Matthew Thompson netted twice as Galway came from behind to defeat Leitrim by 2-19 to 0-14 at Tuam Stadium to move into the Connacht FBD Football League final.

item.title: Westmeath net five times against Offaly to book O'Byrne Cup final spot
item.description: Westmeath booked their place in the O'Byrne Cup final thanks to a 5-10 to 2-8 victory over Offaly at TEG Cusack Park this afternoon.

item.title: Six-time All-Ireland winner Treacy retires from Cork duty
item.description: Cork camogie defender Laura Treacy has called time on her inter-county career after 14 years with the Rebels.

item.title: Watch: Hickey the hero as Kilbrittain claim All-Ireland junior glory
item.description: Mark Hickey's free in injury-time proved the difference as Kilbrittain (Cork) edged 13-man Easkey (Sligo) by 0-19 to 0-18 at Croke Park to claim the All-Ireland club junior hurling championship title.

item.title: O'Neill goal helps steer Kildare past Dubs to O'Byrne Cup final
item.description: Kildare will play Westmeath in the O'Byrne Cup final next Friday night after defeating Dublin by 1-22 to 1-13 at Cedral St Conleth's Park this evening.

item.title: Upperchurch-Drombane come out on top in extra time epic to claim All-Ireland club IHC crown
item.description: Upperchurch-Drombane (Tipperary) are All-Ireland club intermediate hurling champions after edging Tooreen (Mayo) by 4-20 to 2-24 in a thrilling final at Croke Park this evening.
